def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x:sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    hr=[r for r in range(h) if all(v!=bg for v in grid[r])]
    vc=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]!=bg for r in range(h))]
    out=[]
    for r0,r1 in zip(hr,hr[1:]):
        row=[]
        for c0,c1 in zip(vc,vc[1:]):
            vals=[grid[r0][c0],grid[r0][c1],grid[r1][c0],grid[r1][c1]]
            counts={v:vals.count(v) for v in set(vals) if v!=bg}
            row.append(max(counts,key=counts.get) if counts and max(counts.values())>=3 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
